Banner Finance Workflow Access

From the ORA eTraining module "Navigating Banner: Essentials for Research Administration" (lesson 1 of 12).
How to Access Your Project Funds in Banner
Principal investigators and their designated support staff are responsible for actively monitoring their project budgets to support fiscal oversight and research compliance. Banner access allows PIs to review grant spending and other project activity. At Morgan, PIs must be granted Banner access through Workflow before they can monitor project financial activity. A PI's Banner access should be request by their school's Budget Officer. Once access is established, PIs may submit finance access Workflow requests for grant-funded employees on an as-needed basis.
Complete the content above before moving on.

Banner Links Homepage
Submitting a Banner finance access request is an action handled in Workflow (a system utilized for a number of user-initiated access requests). Please make your way to the Banner Links homepage here and select the Workflow icon. You will be prompted to enter your MSU credentials.
Workflow: My Processes
On the left side of the screen you will see the "User Profile" taskbar under which is a link titled "My Processes."
Banner Finance Security Access Request
Select "Banner Finance Security Access Request" on the My Processes page. Please Note: If this workflow link is unavailable, contact Dr. Sophia Jacobs (sophia.jacobs@morgan.edu) in the Office of the Comptroller for assistance in adding it to your processes.
Enter Workflow Specifics
Here you must name the Workflow. A great example would be "Employee Name Finance Access Request." You also need to add the MSU email address of the employee for whom access is being requested. Now click the "Start Workflow" button.
Select Workflow
You may need to refresh your browser page a few times for the workflow to load. Once loaded, select the correct workflow action.
Confirm Employee and Supervisor Information
For each finance access request you will need to have the following information: Employee Email Address (auto-populates) Employee Campus Phone Number Affiliation (Employee Status such as Staff or Faculty) Supervisor Name, Department, Email Address, and Phone #
Enter Start Date and Request Type
Access Start Date Type of Request To add an individual to a new index/project the correct option is "Add New Banner User". Additionally here you can select to remove or edit existing access for project employees.
Select Appropriate Role
For finance access a user can either be a requisitioner or an approver. A requisitioner is responsible for initiating the requests for action, while an approver is responsible for reviewing and approving those actions. A user cannot hold both roles simultaneously. Select "New/Add" on the correct classification.
Select Desired Access
Select "New/Add" to request the appropriate access based on the activity of the employee's position. The three access options provided here are: Budget Transfer : Grants the user the ability to request funds move from one pool level of the project budget to another. Purchasing Card : Grants the user the ability to reconcile their monthly purchasing card activity in Native Banner. Budget Query : Grants the user the ability to review project costs and encumbrances in Banner.
Enter Project Index(s)
Please enter the index number of the budget(s) to which the user needs to have access to or to terminate that access. The form initiator can request the new user have view only access, query and post access, or can terminate access to that index. Once completed click on the "I approve this request" button and click "Complete" at the bottom. The access request will be reviewed by Finance and Management.
